document.pages: Physical/printed p.32: shaft alignment ring; physical p.166: edition

modelingNotes: ABB p.32 identifies OHZX10 / 1SCA022661R3610 as a black mechanical shaft alignment ring for handles OH_45...275J5...12; catalog mass 0.23 kg.
The ring improves operation when handle and shaft are misaligned. It has no electrical terminals, functions or fixed electrical links; associated switch and enclosure bonding are separate.
Historical handle compatibility is recorded without asserting current or installed fit. No electrical ratings are assigned.
ALIGNMENT is an authoring alias for a mechanical interface, not a manufacturer terminal marking. Use an accessory documentation view.

connectionCoverage.notes: Mechanical shaft alignment ring only. No power, return, PE/bond, shield, signal, communication or auxiliary-contact terminals; no required connections or fixed electrical links.

ALIGNMENT.description: Mechanical alignment interface only; no electrical pins.
